Name: DisplayDeck
Author: NPL Audio

Actions.Name: Apply profile
Actions.Tooltip: Applies one of your saved DisplayDeck profiles (display layout and audio). Lights up while it is the active profile.

Actions.Name: Next profile
Actions.Tooltip: Applies the next saved profile, wrapping around. Useful when you have more profiles than keys.

Actions.Name: Undo layout
Actions.Tooltip: Goes back to the display layout from before the last change.

Actions.Name: Audio output
Actions.Tooltip: Makes one playback device the default, with an optional spatial sound format. Lights up while it is the default.

Actions.Name: Profile dial
Actions.Tooltip: Turn to browse your saved profiles; press or tap to apply the one shown. Green while it is the active profile. (Stream Deck +)

Actions.Name: Audio dial
Actions.Tooltip: Turn to browse your playback devices; press or tap to make the one shown the default. Green while it is the default. (Stream Deck +)

TriggerDescription.Push: Make the shown device the default
TriggerDescription.Touch: Make the shown device the default

Actions.Name: Status
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the current profile and the default playback device. For the Stream Deck Neo info bar, or a Stream Deck + dial.

Description: Switch your monitor layouts and audio devices with a key. Requires DisplayDeck running on the same PC.
